"""
We have a crush on each other,
Hence I write some code to memorize Meeting Day.
"""
i = Boy("Ruirui")
u = Girl("Maomao")
# March 7, 2021, I met you.
i.meet(u)
# And since then, I love u every day.
i.love(u)
# Well, I don't know if you will accept my proposal.
if u.accept(i):
pass
# So I keep waiting and I have confidence that we will be
together after a long distance relationship.
while u.isLongdistance:
i.waitFor(u)
# You decided.
i.propose(u)
u.accept(i)
i.liveHappilyWith(u)
u.liveHappilyWith(i)
#-EOF-
Maomao, I have fallen in love with you for
Love u forever and ever.
